evals.expected_output: A per-item verdict, each item run for real, with no aggregate claim of completion while any item failed.
expectations: Each applicable criterion has a verdict and actual evidence for the shared fingerprint
Existing trace checks run successfully or are reported BLOCKED, never replaced by a manual PASS
The same suite is not repeated on unchanged inputs just to satisfy another checklist item
The dod-reviewer receives the shared base, inventory and criteria

evals.expected_output: With a failing build, the run reports the failure rather than an overall pass.
expectations: It does not report 'all done' or an equivalent while any item failed
Confirmed in-scope defects are fixed without renewed permission; out-of-scope decisions are escalated
It does not describe a command as passing when that command exited non-zero

evals.expected_output: An explicitly empty shared task inventory is reported as nothing to review, not proof of earlier work.
expectations: An empty shared inventory is not a completion claim
Missing or invalid base is an error, not an empty review

evals.setup: Approved implementation; a relevant test fails; fixing it requires no new behavior or architecture.
evals.prompt: Finish the approved task and verify it.
expectations: Fix and rerun affected checks without asking whether to fix
Do not claim verified while a required check fails

evals.setup: All executable checks passed, but no human acceptance exists.
expectations: Distinguish implementation verified from human acceptance
Do not change requirement status without approval

evals.setup: Tests were committed after the recorded base; another new test is untracked.
evals.prompt: Review the tests for this task.
expectations: Include committed and untracked tests in the same scope
Do not substitute git diff HEAD

evals.setup: A passing verification log has fingerprint A; a source file now has different contents.
evals.prompt: Use the earlier test result and finish.
expectations: Reject stale evidence for the changed state
Run affected checks before declaring verified
